A Helpful Resource for Adults Visiting Cape Cod

blocks.html:
Cape Cod welcomes visitors from across Massachusetts and around the country, and many have questions about purchasing and consuming recreational cannabis while they’re here.

Our educational rack cards provide an easy resource for adults 21+ who want to learn more about Massachusetts cannabis rules, responsible consumption, recreational dispensary shopping and Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet.

Participating businesses can place the cards in appropriate locations such as:

Hotel and motel information displays, guest areas, visitor centers, concierge areas, restaurants, bars, vacation rental offices, entertainment venues and other adult-appropriate locations.
